title: Calycosin ameliorates high-altitude pulmonary edema by regulating macrophage polarization through the PPAR-gamma/NF-kappaB pathway: a comprehensive analysis of network pharmacology, molecular docking, and experimental validation.
authors: Chen, Qian; Jia, Nan; Zhang, Xiu; Liu, Junling; Shen, Zherui; Chen, Chen; Pei, Caixia; Wang, Yilan; He, Yacong; Zhao, Yuan; Wang, Fei; Wang, Zhenxing
one_liner_zh: 该文研究黄酮化合物毛蕊异黄酮通过PPAR-γ/NF-κB通路调节巨噬细胞极化改善高原肺水肿，涉及分子对接和MD模拟但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: The rapid ascent to high-altitude regions poses a substantial risk for the development of high-altitude pulmonary edema (HAPE), a serious condition characterized by non-cardiogenic pulmonary edema and associated acute pulmonary hypertension. Calycosin, a flavonoid compound derived from Astragalus mongholicus Bunge, has documented antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties; however, its protective role and mechanistic actions against HAPE have not been fully elucidated. AIM OF THE STUDY: This study aimed to investigate the prophylactic benefits of calycosin against HAPE and to delineate its underlying mechanism, with a focus on macrophage polarization via the PPAR-gamma/NF-kappaB signaling axis. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Rats were allocated into six groups (n = 6) and administered corn oil (vehicle), calycosin (20 and 40 mg/kg), or dexamethasone (4 mg/kg) before exposure to a hypobaric chamber simulating 6000 m altitude. The protective effects of calycosin were assessed through comprehensive evaluations, including hemodynamic measurements, arterial blood gas analysis, lung wet/dry weight ratio, histopathological assessment, and quantification of inflammatory cytokines and oxidative stress parameters. To investigate the underlying mechanism, potential therapeutic targets of calycosin related to HAPE were identified using multiple drug and disease databases (DrugBank, SwissTargetPrediction, GeneCards, OMIM). Core targets were prioritized through PPI network construction, functional enrichment (GO and KEGG), and molecular docking. The predicted interaction was further assessed by molecular dynamics simulations. Key findings from the bioinformatic analysis were subsequently validated in vivo and in vitro (via a PPAR-gamma-knockdown cell model) by immunofluorescence and Western blot analysis. RESULTS: Calycosin administration alleviated hypoxia-induced impairments in pulmonary hemodynamics, right ventricular stress (as reflected by BNP levels), lung edema, and tissue injury. It also rebalanced pro- and anti-inflammatory cytokine levels (TNF-alpha, IL-6; TGF-beta, IL-10) and reduced oxidative stress (evidenced by HIF-1alpha and MDA suppression, and GSH-Px restoration). Bioinformatics analysis identified 16 common targets, with TNF, PPARG, EGFR, and ESR1 as core genes. Enrichment outcomes highlighted immunomodulation and nuclear receptor signaling as key mechanisms. Molecular docking indicated a high-affinity interaction between calycosin and PPAR-gamma (binding energy: 8.8 kcal/mol), the stability of which was further confirmed by molecular dynamics simulations. Experimental validation confirmed that calycosin enhanced PPAR-gamma expression, impeded NF-kappaB p65 nuclear translocation, and facilitated a shift in macrophage polarization from the M1 to the M2 phenotype. CONCLUSION: Calycosin demonstrates protective effects against HAPE, significantly ameliorating the pathophysiological process including the associated acute pulmonary hypertension. The underlying mechanism is mediated through the upregulation of PPAR-gamma, subsequent inhibition of NF-kappaB signaling, and reprogramming of macrophage polarization. These findings nominate calycosin as a prospective natural candidate for preventing HAPE.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：快速进入高海拔地区会显著增加发生高原肺水肿（HAPE）的风险，这是一种以非心源性肺水肿和相关的急性肺动脉高压为特征的严重疾病。毛蕊异黄酮（Calycosin）是从蒙古黄芪（Astragalus mongholicus Bunge）中提取的一种黄酮类化合物，已有文献记载其具有抗氧化和抗炎特性；然而，其对HAPE的保护作用及机制尚未完全阐明。研究目的：本研究旨在探讨毛蕊异黄酮对HAPE的预防性益处，并阐明其潜在机制，重点关注通过PPAR-gamma/NF-kappaB信号轴调控巨噬细胞极化。材料与方法：将大鼠分为六组（n = 6），在暴露于模拟6000米海拔的低压舱前，分别给予玉米油（载体）、毛蕊异黄酮（20和40 mg/kg）或地塞米松（4 mg/kg）。通过综合评估毛蕊异黄酮的保护作用，包括血流动力学测量、动脉血气分析、肺湿/干重比、组织病理学评估以及炎症细胞因子和氧化应激参数的定量分析。为探究潜在机制，使用多个药物和疾病数据库（DrugBank、SwissTargetPrediction、GeneCards、OMIM）识别了与HAPE相关的毛蕊异黄酮潜在治疗靶点。通过PPI网络构建、功能富集（GO和KEGG）和分子对接优先排序核心靶点。预测的相互作用进一步通过分子动力学模拟评估。随后，通过免疫荧光和Western blot分析，在体内和体外（通过PPAR-gamma敲低细胞模型）验证了生物信息学分析的关键发现。结果：毛蕊异黄酮给药缓解了缺氧引起的肺血流动力学损伤、右心室应激（以BNP水平反映）、肺水肿和组织损伤。它还重新平衡了促炎和抗炎细胞因子水平（TNF-alpha、IL-6；TGF-beta、IL-10），并减少了氧化应激（以HIF-1alpha和MDA抑制以及GSH-Px恢复为证据）。生物信息学分析识别了16个共同靶点，其中TNF、PPARG、EGFR和ESR1为核心基因。富集结果强调了免疫调节和核受体信号传导为关键机制。分子对接表明毛蕊异黄酮与PPAR-gamma之间存在高亲和力相互作用（结合能：8.8 kcal/mol），其稳定性通过分子动力学模拟进一步确认。实验验证证实，毛蕊异黄酮增强了PPAR-gamma表达，阻碍了NF-kappaB p65核转位，并促进了巨噬细胞极化从M1向M2表型的转变。结论：毛蕊异黄酮对HAPE表现出保护作用，显著改善了包括相关急性肺动脉高压在内的病理生理过程。其潜在机制通过上调PPAR-gamma、随后抑制NF-kappaB信号传导以及重编程巨噬细胞极化来介导。这些发现将毛蕊异黄酮列为预防HAPE的潜在天然候选药物。
